recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結副皮質與竇內可見淡粉紅色、片狀的組織球樣細胞浸潤，中間夾雜嗜酸性球；高倍下細胞具咖啡豆狀核溝（nuclear grooves）與淡嗜酸性胞質，免疫染色 S100、CD1a 與 langerin 陽性且避開濾泡，符合淋巴結蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: Pale eosinophilic sheets and nodules of histiocytoid cells expanding paracortex and sinuses, sparing residual lymphoid follicles
Medium-to-large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Oval, folded to reniform nuclei with longitudinal grooves (coffee-bean nuclei), fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous admixed eosinophils around the lesional cell aggregates
Lesional cells strongly positive for S100 (nuclear and cytoplasmic), membranous CD1a and granular cytoplasmic langerin (unlabeled IHC panels)
describe_en: Sections of lymph node show partial effacement by pale eosinophilic sheets and nodules of histiocytoid cells that expand the paracortex and sinuses and surround residual lymphoid follicles, with focal hemorrhage. At high power the lesional cells have abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved (coffee-bean) nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, accompanied by numerous eosinophils; no significant pleomorphism is seen. Immunohistochemical stains (panels unlabeled) show the lesional cells to be diffusely positive with a nuclear/cytoplasmic pattern consistent with S100, a crisp membranous pattern consistent with CD1a, and a granular cytoplasmic pattern consistent with langerin, sparing the follicles. Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive Langerhans cells are confined to nodular paracortical expansions with interdigitating dendritic cells and melanin-laden macrophages, without sinus-filling sheets or conspicuous eosinophil clusters.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large with round nuclei, visible nucleoli and emperipolesis, are S100+ but CD1a- and langerin-negative, and are accompanied by plasma cells rather than eosinophils.
Langerhans cell sarcoma shows overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli and brisk mitoses, unlike the bland grooved nuclei seen here.
cHL has CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background, whereas the grooved histiocytoid cells here are CD1a+/langerin+.

stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled, likely S100, CD1a, langerin)
captions: H&E, low power: pale eosinophilic sheets of histiocytoid cells expanding paracortex and sinuses around residual follicles
H&E, medium power: sheet of pale grooved Langerhans cells adjacent to a residual lymphoid follicle
H&E, high power: Langerhans cells with grooved coffee-bean nuclei admixed with numerous eosinophils
IHC (nuclear and cytoplasmic pattern, likely S100): diffuse positivity of lesional cells
IHC (membranous pattern, likely CD1a), low power: interconnected sheets of positive cells sparing follicles
IHC (granular cytoplasmic pattern, likely langerin/CD207): strong staining of lesional cells, negative follicle
